notes: Three known defects identified by human review of the 2026-05-18 Opus 4.7 enhancement run. The AI fixed many similar issues elsewhere in the document but missed these specific cases. Each defect represents a class of error generalisable to other documents.

defects.description: Inline 'in $Z$' was not converted to 'in $\mathbb{Z}$' on line 53, despite the AI correctly applying the same conversion in six other math-mode positions within the same document.

On the induction conclusion line, '|n+1|^{2}' should be '(n+1)^{2}' — the expression appears correctly as '(n+1)^{2}' in eight other lines of the same proof, making this an outlier that any internal-consistency check would catch.

In the Remainder Theorem proof, '5 / n' appears four times but should be '5 \mid n' (number theory 'divides' notation). The OCR was internally inconsistent — it produced '5 \mid n' correctly in the question stem and final conclusion. The AI should have harmonised the four wrong instances to match.
